name: read_newspaper
text: A person stands reading a large unfolded newspaper. Hold it wide open with both hands far apart at the left and right edges, about sixty centimeters apart, arms bent in front of the chest. The head tilts downward to read the center of the newspaper. Keep the wide newspaper reading pose steadily with small natural weight shifts.

review.notes_zh: 双手约54厘米分开持展开报纸、低头阅读。首版手距近1米且抬头，修正版沿用已选看报走路的持握位置，通过等骨长手臂姿势参考和低头朝向全身约束重新生成。
